name: ask
description: 向用户提问并阻塞等待回复。当需要澄清、决策或仅用户能提供的信息时使用。支持四种回答类型：answerType="text" 自由文本（缺省）；"single" 单选（需提供 2-6 个 options）；"multi" 多选（需提供 options）；"boolean" 是/否。前端始终会附加「其他」自由输入项，用户也可能取消提问。返回格式固定为「问题 + 用户回答」，便于完整理解上下文。等待无默认超时。
description_en: Ask the user a question and block until the reply arrives. Use when you need clarification, a decision, or information only the user can provide. Four answer types: answerType="text" free text (default); "single" single choice (requires 2-6 options); "multi" multiple choice (requires options); "boolean" yes/no. The frontend always appends an "Other" free-input option, and the user may cancel the question. Returns a fixed "question + user answer" format for full context. No default timeout while waiting.

question.description: 要向用户提问的问题。请具体且简洁。
question.description_en: The question to ask the user. Be specific and concise.

answerType.description: 回答类型。text=自由文本（缺省）；single=单选；multi=多选；boolean=是/否
answerType.description_en: Answer type. text=free text (default); single=single choice; multi=multiple choice; boolean=yes/no

options.description: 候选项列表。answerType 为 single/multi 时必填（2-6 项）；前端会自动附加「其他」自由输入项
options.description_en: List of candidate options. Required when answerType is single/multi (2-6 items); the frontend automatically appends an "Other" free-input option

defaultAnswer.description: 预填的默认回答文本（可选，仅 text 类型）
defaultAnswer.description_en: Pre-filled default answer text (optional, text type only)
